content.text: 5. REMOVE FUEL PUMP FILTER FROM FUEL PUMP

items: (b) Remove the clip and pull out the filter.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of fuel pump with filter, rubber cushion, and connection to fuel hose

content.text: 1. INSTALL FUEL PUMP FILTER TO FUEL PUMP
2. INSTALL FUEL PUMP TO FUEL PUMP BRACKET

items: (a) Insert the outlet port of the fuel pump into the fuel hose.
(b) Install the rubber cushion to the lower side of the fuel pump.
(c) Push the lower side of the fuel pump, together with the rubber cushion, into the fuel pump bracket.

content.description: Illustration showing installation of fuel pump bracket onto fuel tank with gasket

items: (a) Place the bracket with a new gasket on the fuel tank.

content.text: When installing the fuel tank, refer to FI-58 for the installation position of the protector and hose and the tightening torque.
